value.rationale: The complete fixed-weight-two universe is a natural intermediate between one-marker sparse subsequences and the full binary length-k universe. A new triangular pair-coverage obstruction gives a nontrivial lower leading constant, and an explicit all-target construction gives a matching \(\sqrt{k}\) order. This is an infinite asymptotic structural answer, not a routine finite table or renaming of a known SCS result.
